summary: Reuse the current decoded settings import across effective startup-setting reads.
details: The startup reader keeps one decode for unchanged import text and helper codec identities, including invalid imports, and releases it for empty or absent imports.

Current setting registration and catalog validation still run for every read. Invalid or unavailable entries retain direct-setting fallback, false and zero values retain their values, and no startup setting is mutated.

Controlled API call counts cover reuse and invalidation. The existing native profile round-trip fixture now covers repeated effective reads and changed text; exact MIR 4.2.1 native package and performance qualification remains pending.
